claim_text: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, combining deterministic L0 route-policy dispatch with multi-agent orchestration contracts and replay-key audit manifests for reproducible runtime traces.
Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization by pairing partner deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting and revenue target ownership.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering, evaluation gates, and rollback controls that harden production execution.

Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks via managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms on AWS and Databricks Lakehouse, integrating dense sparse exact retrieval design with provider and egress governance.
Scaled the platform engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke delivery into reusable, commercialized AI platform IP and an operating model for agentic AI.
